test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 02 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT an example of a public sector company?
solution:
The correct answer is__** NSE.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Public sector **companies are those that are** owned and operated by the government.**
 
• They are established to provide essential services to the **public and contribute to the country's economic growth.**
 
• Public sector companies are usually involved in** industries such as energy, healthcare, transportation, and defense.**​
 
• **NSE (National Stock Exchange) is not a public sector company but a private company. **
 
 
• It is one of the leading stock exchanges in India and provides trading platforms for various financial instruments such as stocks, derivatives, and currencies.
 
• NSE was established in 1992 and has a market capitalization of over $2 trillion.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **SAIL**

 
 
• **SAIL (Steel Authority of India Limited) **is a public sector company **owned by the Government of India.**
 
• It is one of the largest steel-making companies in India and operates several steel plants across the country.
 
• SAIL is involved in the production and distribution of steel products for various industries such as construction, infrastructure, and automobile.
 
 
 
• **ONGC**
 
 
• **ONGC (Oil and Natural Gas Corporation)** is a public sector **company owned by the Government of India.**
 
• It is India's largest oil and gas exploration and production company and operates several oil fields across the country.
 
• ONGC is involved in the exploration, production, and distribution of oil and gas products for various industries such as energy, transportation, and petrochemicals.
 
 
 
• **BHEL**
 
 
• ** BHEL (Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited)** is a **public sector company owned by the Government of India.**
 
• It is one of the largest engineering and manufacturing companies in India and specializes in the production of power equipment such as turbines, generators, and boilers.
 
• BHEL is involved in the design, development, and manufacturing of power equipment for various industries such as energy, infrastructure, and defense.
